melting_point.range_text: The melting point, determined as the onset of the melting peak, typically lies in the range from about 121° C. to 125° C.

analytics.conditions: differential scanning calorimetry, aluminum closed cup, heating rate 10 K/min
analytics.raw_text: Thermogram of form C: characteristic melting peak in the range from 120 to 132 deg C; the melting point taken as the onset of the melting peak typically lies from about 121 to 125 deg C, in particular from 122 to 125 deg C. Lines 284-285.

notes: Crystalline form C of tembotrione: the same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice, and not a distinct chemical entity. Formula C17H16ClF3O6S. This record is form C. Thermal data only; the section names no other substance. melting_point carries the onset range the patent itself calls the melting point, 121 to 125 deg C, rather than the 120 to 132 deg C peak range, which is recorded in the DSC analytics entry. The alias is capitalised as 'Form C' because that is how this section prints it; the lowercase 'form C' does not occur in these lines. is_section_product is false because this section only characterises the form and no step of it produces anything.
